Metadata.title: Utrum — prioritize by comparing two at a time
Metadata.description: Make a list, pick the criterion and decide what comes first by comparing two items at a time. Then compare your view with everyone else's. No sign-up.

About.title: About Utrum
About.intro: Utrum helps decide what comes first: instead of sorting a whole list in your head, you choose between two items at a time. "Utrum" is Latin for "which of the two?". It's free, has no sign-up and is open source.

how.title: How it works
how.p1: The organizer makes the list and writes the criterion, the question shown on every comparison: "Which is more urgent?", "Which do you prefer?".
how.p2: With the quick method, the app slots each item into place with as few questions as possible, like sorting a hand of cards. With the complete method, every pair is compared and the item with the most wins comes first.
how.p3: Each person gets the comparisons in a different order, so the order doesn't pull the choices.

visibility.title: Who sees what
visibility.p1: Each person only sees the others' rankings after completing their own, so nobody is swayed by someone else's opinion. The organizer sees everyone's progress and rankings.

safety.title: How to tell it's safe
safety.p1: Utrum only asks for your name. It never asks for a password, verification code, phone number, ID, card details or payment. If a page asks for that, it isn't Utrum.

who.title: Who makes it
who.p1: Utrum is an independent project made in Brazil and run by {operator}, the people behind QuemLeva and AmigoSecreto.

code.title: Open source
code.p1: The code is open, under the AGPL-3.0 license, and anyone can check how the ranking is computed <repo>on GitHub</repo>.

Privacy.title: Privacy policy
Privacy.intro: This policy explains, in plain language, what data Utrum keeps, why and for how long. Utrum has no sign-up and does not sell or share data for advertising.

collect.title: What we keep
collect.p1: What the organizer writes: the list's name, criterion, explanation and items.
collect.p2: Each participant's name, the items each one suggests, the choice made on each comparison and the ranking that comes out of them.
collect.p3: A random device code, which recognizes you without a sign-up.
collect.p4: To prevent abuse, we log list creation with a scrambled version (hash) of the IP address. That log is deleted within 1 day.

visibility.title: Who sees what
visibility.p1: Anyone with the list link sees its name, criterion, items and the names of who is taking part.
visibility.p2: Through your personal link, you see your choices and your ranking. After completing your ranking, you also see each participant's ranking, with their name.
visibility.p3: The organizer link shows everyone's progress and ranking and lets you change the list. Keep that link to yourself.

device.title: On your device
device.p1: The browser stores the device code, your links (organizer and personal) and the "My lists" list, plus a cookie with your chosen language. We don't use advertising or tracking cookies.

providers.title: Services we use
providers.p1: Supabase (database, with servers in São Paulo) and Vercel (website hosting). They process data only so Utrum works and may keep technical access logs, such as IP addresses, under their own policies.

retention.title: For how long
retention.p1: Lists are kept while Utrum is online, so the links keep working. The organizer can delete everything at any time, and you can ask for deletion through the contact below.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.p1: Under Brazil's LGPD, you can ask to see, correct or delete your data, or a whole list. Write to the contact below and include the link.
rights.p2: In the app itself, you can undo or restart your choices, and the organizer can remove participants and items.

controller.title: Data controller
controller.p1: The data controller is {operator}. If this policy changes, the date at the top is updated.

Terms.title: Terms of use
Terms.intro: By using Utrum, you agree to these terms.

service.title: The service
service.p1: Utrum is free and provided as is, with no guarantee that it will always work or be error-free. It may change or shut down; whenever possible, we'll give notice. Rankings support a decision; they are not the decision.

content.title: What you write
content.p1: You are responsible for what you write in lists, criteria and items. Don't use Utrum for illegal, offensive or misleading content, or for spam. We may remove lists that break these rules.

links.title: Links
links.p1: Anyone with the list link can see the list and join. Your personal link holds your choices: don't pass it on. Don't share the organizer link.

license.title: Open source
license.p1: Utrum's code is under the AGPL-3.0 license.

law.title: Governing law
law.p1: These terms are governed by the laws of Brazil.

Install.title: Add to home screen
Install.intro: Utrum then sits with your other apps and opens straight to your lists, no link to find.
Install.ios1: Tap the Share button (the square with an arrow pointing up) in Safari's toolbar.
Install.ios2: Scroll down and tap "Add to Home Screen".
Install.ios3: Tap "Add". The Utrum icon shows up on your home screen.
Install.menu1: Open the browser menu (the three dots ⋮).
Install.menu2: Tap "Add to Home screen" or "Install app" and confirm.
